name: Afterglow
headline: When does your evening slow down?
summary: A warm, focused setup screen for choosing a wind-down time.
observed: A three-part progress indicator has its middle step highlighted.
The selected time is 10:45 pm, repeated in the large readout and hour/minute picker.
A back control and “Set my evening” action frame the next step. The copy connects the choice to timing the last coffee.
keep: Localized amber light, a small sculptural moon and a quiet cream surface.
A single clear decision with generous space around the selected time.
discuss: Decide whether the product stays focused on coffee timing or follows the later evening-routine direction.
Specify picker movement, keyboard and screen-reader controls, time-format preferences and what happens after confirmation.
interaction: The saved image depicts a picker, a back control and a primary action. It does not establish scrolling behavior, allowed minute increments or a saved preference state.

name: Pocket Garden
headline: Your little garden starts here.
summary: An illustrated welcome to a quieter plant journal.
observed: A gardener illustration fills most of the screen and fades into the reading area.
The message says the visitor is already on the early-access list, reinforced by “EARLY ACCESS · SPOT SAVED.”
“Keep me in the loop” is the primary action; “Explore the plant notes” is secondary.
keep: Painterly foliage, coral clothing and warm botanical light.
The gentle transition from illustration to open text and controls.
discuss: Clarify the primary action after a spot has already been saved; distinguish confirmation from notification preferences.
Decide whether the next study remains an early-access journey or begins the plant-care app explored later.
interaction: Both calls to action are shown as static artwork. Signup validation, notification consent and the destination of plant notes are not demonstrated.

name: Home Note
headline: Leave the details. Keep the peace.
summary: A friendly first screen for sharing the small details of family care.
observed: Layered household cards show “Friday with June,” school pickup, a peanut-free snack and a bedtime story.
The lower panel reads “Leave the details. Keep the peace.” with a 01 / 03 marker.
“Create your home note” and “I have an invitation” offer two distinct entry routes.
keep: Peach, citron and burgundy, with tactile household symbols and friendly avatars.
The clear distinction between starting a household and joining one.
discuss: Map the create and invitation routes before adding more screens.
Explore how the illustrated handover becomes an editable, readable note with clear ownership and confirmation.
interaction: The two entry actions and progress marker are visible. The screenshot does not demonstrate a swipe sequence, invitation validation or the editor used after onboarding.

name: Sol
headline: Bright until dusk.
summary: A sunny dashboard combining the forecast with time outside.
observed: Lisbon is selected, with 28°, “Bright until dusk,” and “Feels like 29°.”
Six hourly values run from 14:00 to 19:00: 28°, 29°, 28°, 27°, 25°, 24°. Wind is 12 km/h and humidity is 48%.
A “Best light · 18:30–20:00” row sits above Today, Places and Settings navigation.
keep: The blue sky field, oversized temperature and tactile sun/cloud illustration.
A useful sequence from current weather to hourly trend and daylight.
discuss: Define chart scrubbing, city switching and the destination of the Best light row.
Plan loading, stale-data, offline and location-permission states before implementing live weather.
interaction: The chart, city selector, plus control and three tabs are drawn in one static state. No live forecast, gesture or navigation behavior is demonstrated.

name: Petal
headline: Put the garden back together.
summary: A quiet arrangement game using fragments of a botanical illustration.
observed: Five horizontal botanical strips are shown at different offsets.
The status reads “3 of 5 pieces aligned,” with a partly filled progress bar and 04 / 12 in the header.
Pause, “Show a hint” and “Start again” frame the play area.
keep: Detailed lemon blossom artwork, expressive serif type and restrained coral controls.
The tangible strip arrangement and calm, uncluttered play area.
discuss: Confirm the movement rule and what counts as aligned; the label and visual positions must agree.
Define drag and tap alternatives, hint feedback, reset confirmation and the completed puzzle state.
interaction: The image suggests movable strips through visible handles and offsets. Dragging, snapping, hint behavior and the progress calculation are not implemented here.

name: Daybook
headline: An evening worth keeping.
summary: An editorial daily view that gives outdoor plans a place in the evening.
observed: The header shows Thursday, 18 June, Lisbon, clear skies and 28°.
A daylight arc is labeled 06:12 and 20:58, with “2h 18m of daylight left.”
Two plans are shown: 18:30 Walk by the water for 35 minutes and 19:15 Dinner on the terrace for 60 minutes. Today is selected below the Add an evening plan action.
keep: Burgundy editorial type, a restrained horizon illustration and an open agenda.
The relationship between the daylight arc and a short list of practical plans.
discuss: Make the daylight countdown, current time and selected date consistent in the next iteration.
Define adding and editing a plan, overlapping activities, calendar access and Week / Places navigation.
interaction: The timeline, add action and tab bar are visible in a static image. Time changes, planning forms and calendar integration are not demonstrated.
